messages:
Alex Chen: hey all — accepted the GitHub org invite but I still can't see eng-core repos or teams. also getting weird error enabling 2FA on my phone: 'device not allowed'. who should I ping?

onboarding-bot: welcome to Redwood! :tada: If you accepted the invite but can't see teams/repos, it's usually SSO or team membership delay. For 2FA follow https://docs.redwood.example/ops/2fa. If you need help, @Jordan can check org side.

Jordan: @Alex Chen what's your GitHub handle?

Alex Chen: alexchen-ml

Jordan: thanks. checking now — looks like your org membership is listed but SSO shows "authorization required" (common when you haven't completed the SAML step). Try: GitHub -> Settings -> Organizations -> redwood-inference -> "Authorize SAML for this org" (there should be a blue button).

Alex Chen: I don't see that button in Settings -> Organizations.

Jordan: ok try via gh CLI (needs a token):
```
gh auth login
gh api /orgs/redwood-inference/memberships/alexchen-ml
```
If the API shows "sso_required": true then click the authorize link in the browser org page. If it still doesn't show, ping me and I'll re-send the SSO invite.

Alex Chen: ran gh, it returned sso_required: true. where's the authorize link?

Jordan: open https://github.com/organizations/redwood-inference/sso and you should see a banner with an "Authorize" button. If not, I'll re-trigger SSO from our IdP.

Melanie: FYI People Ops — sometimes new hires hit 2FA/device enrollment issues if they previously had GitHub orgs on the phone. Alex, did you use a personal device that had a prev org auth?

Alex Chen: I did have a different work account on my phone last year.

Rohit Kapoor: I just added Alex to team -> eng-core-dev and gave repo access to redwood-inference/core-serving (write). It can take a couple mins to propagate.

Alex Chen: still can't access core-serving, shows 404 when I try to open the repo page.

Tiago: 404 usually means either not a member yet, or SSO not completed. Once SSO done, log out + log back in to clear tokens. Also check org role.

Jordan: confirmed SSO invite was pending — I re-sent and authorized for alexchen-ml. Alex, try this sequence:
1) log out of github.com on browser
2) clear cookies for github.com (or open incognito)
3) visit https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference and click "Authorize" when prompted
4) wait ~2 min then refresh core-serving

Alex Chen: ok did logout + authorize. 2FA prompt came up during authorize but my YubiKey wasn't working. I removed the old Authy entry and re-enrolled via GitHub TOTP — that fixed 2FA.

Rohit Kapoor: nice — I can see your membership as "member" now. reprovisioned repo perms.

Samir: filed IT ticket RW-789 to track the device/2FA cleanup so People Ops has a record.

Alex Chen: confirmed I can now access redwood-inference/core-serving and see eng-core team. thanks everyone! :thumbsup:

Melanie: welcome aboard, Alex — if anything else blocks your dev setup ping #devex or DM me and I'll connect you with a buddy.

Alex Chen: will do, thanks again :)
